description.value: Audielicious is an eclectic sit-down restaurant in Fort St. John offering an unusually broad menu that spans steakhouse cuts, fresh seafood platters, Filipino cuisine favourites, burgers, and sandwiches all under one roof. The Filipino influence sets it apart from typical northern BC eateries, with dishes like pork shumai, wonton soup, and spring rolls alongside Western classics. It operates as a full-service restaurant with delivery and takeout also available through SkipTheDishes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is a SkipTheDishes delivery page for Audielicious at 9720 100 St, confirming the restaurant is real and active. The phone number (250) 785-5727 matches the OSM tag. The menu confirms takeout/delivery service and includes vegetarian options (vegetable burger, fried vegetable spring rolls); no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities is present on this third-party platform page.
concerns: The OSM website URL points to a third-party delivery platform (SkipTheDishes) rather than the restaurant's own website, limiting the availability of on-site amenity information.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant in Fort St. John confirmed by SkipTheDishes listing with matching address and phone; broad menu makes it a useful stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Vegetable Burger (vegetable patty) and Fried Vegetable Spring Roll (6 pcs), confirming vegetarian options

wow_evidence: steakhouse cuts, fresh seafood platters, Filipino cuisine favourites... full-service restaurant with delivery and takeout
